name: cavemio-tool-call
title: Tool call
description: One tool invocation from arguments to result: preparing, running, done, failed or denied.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The header is a button with aria-expanded; the status badge is announced politely as it changes, and the run time is real text behind the rolling digits.
- Collapsed details are inert, so a folded card can’t trap focus.
- Long values wrap and nested objects show as compact JSON, so wide arguments never break the layout.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion the sweep, spinner, rolls and slides stop; states change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: name / title
props.description: – · The tool’s name as the model calls it, and an optional human label.

props.name: input
props.description: – · Arguments, possibly partial while preparing. Objects render as fields.

props.name: output / renderOutput
props.description: – · The result, shown as fields or JSON, or rendered your way.

props.name: errorText / onRetry
props.description: – · Why it failed, and a Retry button.

props.name: duration
props.description: – · Run time in ms, shown when done.

props.name: icon
props.description: wrench · An icon for the tool.

useCases.title: AI agent chats
useCases.description: Show each tool the agent calls, with its arguments and its result.

useCases.title: Assistants that call APIs
useCases.description: Make an API request visible, so people see what was sent.

useCases.title: Agent debugging
useCases.description: Inspect what a tool received and returned.

useCases.title: Approval flows
useCases.description: Mark a call as denied when the person said no.

features.title: Arguments fill in as written
features.description: They show as fields rather than raw JSON, and the panel eases taller with each one.

features.title: One status pill
features.description: The pill goes from “Preparing” to “Running” to a check, without ever being swapped for another element.

features.title: Run time and result
features.description: The run time rolls up from zero and the output rises in, as fields or JSON, or rendered your way.

features.title: Failures explain themselves
features.description: A failed call opens itself once, shows the reason and offers Retry.

features.title: Denied is a state of its own
features.description: A ban icon and “Denied” say the person declined, so nothing ran.

features.title: Long values don’t break the layout
features.description: Long text wraps and nested objects show as compact JSON. Folded details are inert.

states.title: preparing
states.description: A 1.4s sweep of light crosses "Preparing" while the arguments arrive field by field; the panel eases to each new height over 420ms.

states.title: running
states.description: The icon slot opens (380ms) with a spinner and the label morphs to "Running". The spinner only spins in this state.

states.title: done
states.description: The spinner blurs out as an emerald check draws itself (420ms), the label lifts away and the run time rolls up from zero ("1.2s"); the output rises in as the panel eases to fit.

states.title: error
states.description: An alert icon and "Failed" in red; the card opens itself once to show the reason and a Retry.

states.title: denied
states.description: A ban icon and "Denied": the user declined, so it didn’t run.
